input.code:
def process(load_helicopter_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_helicopter_data.copy()
    # Filter to only the 10 NICC-defined areas (exclude 'Other' and 'Canada' and 'National Interagency Coordination Center')
    nicc_areas = df[~df['Region'].isin(['Other', 'Canada', 'National Interagency Coordination Center'])]
    # Find the area with maximum helicopter requests
    max_row = nicc_areas.loc[nicc_areas['Total Helicopter Requests'].idxmax()]
    return pd.DataFrame([max_row])
